lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected outcomes, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Finish hints were helpful, winning in two out of three tests.
Choose path hints showed no positive effect across five tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no positive effect across two tests.
Home notifications showed no clear effect across two tests.
Evidence remains thin for kinds of changes tested only once.

candidates.title: Full bleed path choice screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path choice screen into a full bleed layout with interactive choice cards showcasing preset vs custom setup experiences.
candidates.why: Path selection has an 81.8% conversion rate and high mean duration (514s), suggesting users benefit from a clearer and more visual visual path layout.

guard.reason: 'choose_path.replace.path_options[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.title: Stage layout adoption certificate redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen to a stage layout featuring a framed certificate display.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the longest completion times in the funnel (1017s mean), and a clean stage presentation elevates the adoption milestone.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop pet audio behavior preferences screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet audio preference screen before completion allowing users to set default sound levels and quiet hours.
candidates.why: 3 support emails explicitly asked how to control, hide, or manage pet interactions and sound behaviors.

new_sound_preferences.headline: Set Pet Sound & Mute Rules
new_sound_preferences.body: Choose whether your pet makes soft sounds, speaks on click, or stays quiet while you work.

guard.reason: screen 'new_sound_preferences' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Pet desktop animation preview flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive idle animation tester component to the pick friend screen so users can preview pet behaviors live on desktop background.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet failures or visual defects, and previewing desktop behaviors sets clear expectations before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Adds a preview component to the pick_friend screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New flow changes in adoption previously led to a severe conversion drop (-6.5%) and require full UI development.

candidates.title: Spotlight layout sign-in screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout highlighting single-click account login and pet data restoration.
candidates.why: Sign-in has an 80% conversion rate and 8 support emails (the highest count) reported pets missing or reset after signing in.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Existing account pet restoration headline
candidates.change: Updates the sign-in screen headline to emphasize that logging in immediately restores existing pets and cloud saves.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an existing account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets & Cloud Progress

guard.reason: Updates headline copy on the sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails, but sign_in copy changes historically show slight negative lift (-0.3%).

candidates.title: Graphics engine preparation checklist on waiting screen
candidates.change: Adds a detailed rendering progress checklist component on the waiting screen showing GPU shader compilation and sprite loading.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop or app stalling before launch, while waiting screen mean time is 2336s.

components.text: Preparing desktop graphics layer & pet sprites...

guard.reason: Adds a rendering progress checklist component to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes have a consistent positive record (+0.5% over 14 tests) addressing high waiting times.

candidates.title: Desktop pet right-click menu guidance hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the home intro screen explaining that right-clicking the pet on desktop opens pet controls, mute, and hide options.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish hints have won 2 out of 3 previous tests.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet on your desktop anytime to change settings, mute sounds, or hide it.

guard.reason: Adds menu guidance hints to the home_intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish hints are proven winners in 2 out of 3 past tests with an average +4.0% lift.

candidates.title: Display resolution compatibility notification on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enables readiness notifications on the waiting screen to inform users as soon as desktop display scaling optimization completes.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in/launch stalling and 3 reported desktop rendering issues.

waiting.hint: We will notify you the moment your pet is rendered and ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Enables readiness notifications and hints on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications showed negative effects (-1.8% over 2 tests) with no clear positive evidence.

candidates.title: Custom pet avatar quality reassurance copy
candidates.change: Updates the photo upload body text to explain how the app automatically enhances uploaded photos into clear 3D desktop avatars.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or poor visually rendered results.

upload_photos.body: Upload any photo of your pet. Our graphics engine automatically sharpens lighting and creates a clean 3D desktop companion.

guard.reason: Updates photo upload body copy to explain avatar generation without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change to address adoption concerns; low implementation cost with moderate potential.

Graphics engine preparation checklist on waiting screen

lessons_next: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected outcomes, though winning tests frequently exceeded expected gains.
Finish hints were helpful, winning in two out of four tests.
Adoption new flows hurt performance, showing worse results across both tests.
Choose path hints showed no positive effect across five tests.
